title: Headphone Sprout Pattern
body:
R1: To begin, CH 31. SC 1 into each CH starting in the 11th CH from the hook (20 total). Tie off.
Leaf R1: To begin, CH 11. SL 1, SC 1, HDC 1, DC 1, TC 2, DC 1, HDC 1, SC 1. SL 2 into the last ST.
R2: Working around into the opposite side of the chain, SL 1, SC 1, HDC 1, DC 1, TC 2, DC 1, HDC 1, SC 1, SL 1. Tie off, leaving a few inches of yarn tail.
Repeat R1-2 to create the second leaf.
Next, securely tie both of the leaves to the top end of the stem using the tapestry needle and the yarn tails, placing one on each corner stitch.

title: First Yes by duckwave, Lyrics
body:
First Yes

Verse 1

You were my first yes
My first call past midnight
First name I trusted
With the worst parts of me

I didn't know love
Could feel that steady
Like leaning my weight
On something that wouldn't leave

Pre-Chorus 1

I thought if I held on
Hard enough, long enough
We'd outrun the cracks
Before they showed

But growing up doesn't ask
If you're ready or not
It just keeps moving
And lets go

Chorus 1

You were my first love
That will always be true
And losing you broke me
In ways I grew through

Now I laugh when I say your name
No weight, no fear
You're not my heartbreak
You're my best friend here

Verse 2

I remember the quiet
After we called it over
Every street felt longer
Every song hit wrong

I tried being angry
Tried cutting the cord
But your name still sounded
Like home in my mouth

Pre-Chorus 2

I had to sit with the pain
Let it say what it needed
Let the future fall apart
Before I could believe it

Turns out letting go
Isn't losing control
Sometimes it's just
Choosing to grow

Chorus 2

You were my first love
That will always be true
And losing you broke me
In ways I grew through

I don't flinch when I say your name
I'm still right here
You're not my heartbreak
You're my best friend here

Bridge

I don't miss who we were
I don't wish it stayed the same
I don't want us rewritten
Just understood, not erased

What we had was real
And it mattered somehow
But this version of us
Is the one I trust now

Chorus 3

You were my first love
That will always be true
And losing you broke me
In ways I grew through

Now I smile when I say your name
No weight, no fear
You're not my heartbreak
You're my best friend here

Outro

Some loves burn fast
Some loves stay
This one learned
A better way
